articles.summary: - Expanded collaboration builds upon research momentum in developing next-generation bispecific immunotherapies using CytomX’s PROBODY ® and Regeneron's Veloci-Bi ® platforms - - CytomX to receive $37 million target selection payment for two additional programs selected - - Regeneron secures option
articles.title: CytomX Announces Expansion of Strategic Research Collaboration with Regeneron in the Field of Conditional Bispecific Therapeutics for the Treatment of Cancer
